ESSENTIALS 2.0 · FLOW INSPIRATION · 07-REPORTS
Reports — flow inspiration

Center-wide and cross-course reporting for Essentials 2.0: scheduled digests for deans, cohort comparison, AI evaluation review/approve, utilisation KPIs, and easy sharing. Sources: Mobbin and Refero (web). Date: 2026-09-30. Course-level reports from inside a course are covered in courses/08-recordings-course-reports; this gallery focuses on delivery and center-level analytics.

Baseline. Today Essentials ships four reports (Responses, Group Performance, Performance Matrix, Skill Development). Skill areas depend on program-wide naming abbreviations; an activity must be assigned before data is collected, so late setup loses data. Accreditation packs are hand-assembled.
